heading.en: Origins and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 據新南威爾斯大學坎培拉分校AIF專案頁面（羅斯·馬利特撰），伊文·麥基1882年4月7日生於新南威爾斯格拉夫頓，1904年取得悉尼大學文學士學位，1905至1910年在悉尼文法學校任教。1914年8月27日他受任澳洲帝國軍第4步兵營副官；1915年8月6日參與洛恩派恩（Lone Pine）攻擊。
body.en: Per the AIF Project page at UNSW Canberra (by Ross Mallett), Iven Mackay was born at Grafton, New South Wales, on 7 April 1882, graduated BA at the University of Sydney in 1904 and taught at Sydney Grammar from 1905 to 1910. On 27 August 1914 he was appointed to the AIF as adjutant of the 4th Infantry Battalion, and on 6 August 1915 he took part in the attack on Lone Pine.

heading.en: Interwar rank and the 6th Division

body.zh-Hant: 1937年3月24日，麥基出任第2師師長並升准將，同年7月1日正式升少將。1939年他在陸軍資歷名單上排第七。第2澳洲帝國軍組建第二個師時，布萊梅升任第1軍司令，麥基獲遴選接掌第6師，1940年4月4日就任。部下因他從前的教師身分，稱他為「奇普斯先生」。
body.en: On 24 March 1937 Mackay took command of the 2nd Division and was promoted to brigadier, and he was promoted to major general on 1 July 1937. In 1939 he ranked seventh on the army's seniority list. When a second division of the Second AIF was raised, Blamey was elevated to command of I Corps and Mackay was selected to replace him as commander of the 6th Division, taking over on 4 April 1940. His men nicknamed him "Mister Chips", after his civilian occupation.

heading.en: Bardia and the Greek campaign

body.zh-Hant: 麥基率第6師打第一仗，1941年1月在利比亞巴迪亞，攻下該鎮並俘虜4萬名義大利軍人，因此獲封大英帝國爵級司令勳章（KBE）。師的下一場戰役是希臘，來源稱之為徹底的慘敗；他與部下同甘共苦，1941年4月19日空襲時，他的座車被擊中、司機受傷，他仍在原地坐了兩個半小時。因希臘之役，他獲通令嘉獎。1941年9月1日他交卸第6師，返回澳洲。
body.en: Mackay led the 6th Division into its first battle, at Bardia in Libya in January 1941, capturing the town along with 40,000 Italian prisoners, for which he was made a Knight of the British Empire (KBE). The division's next campaign was Greece, which the source calls a complete debacle. He shared the hardships of his men; during a raid on 19 April 1941 he waited out a two-and-a-half-hour attack while his car was hit and his driver wounded. For Greece he was mentioned in despatches. On 1 September 1941 he relinquished command of the 6th Division to return to Australia.

heading.zh-Hant: 本土防務、第二軍與新幾內亞部隊
heading.en: Home Forces, Second Army and New Guinea Force

body.zh-Hant: 返澳後麥基升中將，統帥本土部隊，任務是讓民兵做好抵禦日軍入侵的準備；1942年2月他提交的評估引發日後的「布里斯班線」爭議。1942年4月6日他出任第二軍司令；1943年1月30日布萊梅卸任新幾內亞部隊司令後交給他，他任內正值布納戰事結束與瓦烏的爭奪。他於1943年5月21日回到帕拉馬塔指揮第二軍，後出任澳洲首任駐印度高級專員，至1948年5月。
body.en: Back in Australia Mackay was promoted to lieutenant general and given command of Home Forces, tasked with readying the militia to repel a Japanese invasion; an appreciation he submitted in February 1942 later gave rise to the Brisbane Line controversy. He became commander of the Second Army on 6 April 1942. When Blamey relinquished command of New Guinea Force on 30 January 1943 he handed over to Mackay, whose watch saw the end of the fighting at Buna and the struggle at Wau. Mackay returned to command of Second Army at Parramatta on 21 May 1943, and later served as Australia's first High Commissioner to India until May 1948.

heading.en: Early career and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 據澳洲戰爭紀念館（AWM）館藏頁，約翰·拉瓦拉克1905年8月7日受任常備軍炮兵中尉，1913年初起在英國坎伯利參謀學院受訓，至一戰爆發。1915年2月升任英軍第22師炮兵旅參謀，同年9月赴法國；1916年7月起隨澳洲部隊在第2師參加波濟耶（Pozières）戰役，又在索姆河等戰事擔任第5師炮兵旅參謀。他獲頒傑出服務勳章與法國十字戰功章，1919年9月返澳。
body.en: Per the Australian War Memorial, John Lavarack was commissioned a lieutenant in the Royal Australian Artillery of the Permanent Military Forces on 7 August 1905 and attended the Staff College at Camberley from early 1913 until the First World War began. In February 1915 he became brigade major of the 22nd (British) Divisional Artillery and went to France in September; he joined the Australians in July 1916, being posted to 2nd Division for Pozières, and was brigade major of the 5th Divisional Artillery on the Somme. He won the DSO and the Croix de Guerre, and returned to Australia in September 1919.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰間期參謀要職與總參謀長
heading.en: Interwar staff posts and Chief of the General Staff

body.zh-Hant: 返澳後，拉瓦拉克受派任杜特魯恩皇家軍事學院軍事藝術主任；1925年3月任陸軍總部軍事訓練主任，1927年底赴倫敦帝國國防學院進修，1929年初任陸軍總部軍事行動與情報主任。1933年1月他出任皇家軍事學院院長，1935年4月21日晉升臨時少將並接任總參謀長，越過數位資歷較深的軍官。
body.en: After returning to Australia Lavarack was posted to the Royal Military College, Duntroon, as director of military art; in March 1925 he became director of military training at Army Headquarters, at the end of 1927 he went to the Imperial Defence College in London, and in early 1929 became director of military operations and intelligence. In January 1933 he became commandant of the RMC, and on 21 April 1935 he was promoted temporary major general and took over as Chief of the General Staff, superseding a number of more senior officers.

heading.en: The Middle East and the Syria campaign

body.zh-Hant: 據AWM，拉瓦拉克1940年11月抵達中東。1941年3月隆美爾率軸心軍在利比亞發動攻勢，第7師第18旅被緊急送往托布魯克，支援莫斯黑德少將的第9師。AWM《Operation Exporter》稱，6月18日威爾遜把敘利亞作戰指揮權交給剛由第7師師長升任第1澳洲軍的中將拉瓦拉克；自該日起行動由他指揮。AWM館藏頁同時載明他於6月18日晉升中將、接替布萊梅出任第1軍司令。
body.en: According to the AWM, Lavarack arrived in the Middle East in November 1940. In March 1941 Axis forces under Rommel attacked in Libya and the 18th Brigade of the 7th Division was rushed to Tobruk to support the 9th Australian Division under Major General Morshead. The AWM's Operation Exporter article says Wilson passed command in Syria on 18 June to Lieutenant General Lavarack, just promoted from command of the 7th Division to I Australia Corps, and that from 18 June the operation was commanded by him. The collection page also records his promotion to lieutenant general on 18 June 1941 and his taking command of I Corps in Blamey's place.

heading.zh-Hant: 華盛頓軍事代表團與昆士蘭總督
heading.en: Washington mission and the governorship of Queensland

body.zh-Hant: 1944年2月，拉瓦拉克飛往華盛頓出任澳洲軍事代表團團長；1945年4至6月他是舊金山聯合國國際組織會議澳洲代表團的軍事顧問。他於1946年9月18日退役，同月獲任昆士蘭總督，10月1日宣誓就職；1951年任期延長五年，因健康不佳，1957年1月25日被免除職務。他於1957年12月4日在昆士蘭去世，享壽72歲。
body.en: In February 1944 Lavarack flew to Washington to become head of the Australian Military Mission, and he was military adviser to the Australian delegation at the United Nations Conference on International Organization at San Francisco from April to June 1945. He retired from the army on 18 September 1946, was appointed Governor of Queensland the same month and sworn in on 1 October 1946; his term was extended in 1951 for five years, and because of ill health he was relieved of his duties on 25 January 1957. He died in Queensland on 4 December 1957, aged 72.

heading.en: Origins and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 據澳洲戰爭紀念館（AWM）館藏頁，斯坦利·薩維吉1890年生於維多利亞，1915年3月入伍澳洲帝國軍（二等兵，編號577）。他隨第24營在加里波利作戰，撤退前受任少尉，是洛恩派恩最後留守小隊的一員；在法國因第二次布勒古（Bullecourt）戰役英勇獲頒軍功十字勳章。1918年他被選派參加波斯的「鄧斯特部隊」（Dunsterforce），指揮「烏爾米亞部隊」，獲頒傑出服務勳章。
body.en: Per the Australian War Memorial, Stanley Savige was born in Victoria in 1890 and enlisted in the AIF (Private 577) in March 1915. He served with 24 Battalion at Gallipoli, was commissioned a second lieutenant before the evacuation and was part of the final holding party at Lone Pine. In France he won the Military Cross at the second battle of Bullecourt. In 1918 he was one of a small number of Australians selected for Dunsterforce in Persia, commanding 'Urmia Force', and was awarded the Distinguished Service Order.

enlisted in the AIF (Private 577) in March 1915
He served with 24 Battalion at Gallipoli

heading.en: 17 Brigade and 3 Division

body.zh-Hant: 兩次大戰之間薩維吉留在民兵服役，1939年已是上校。第二澳洲帝國軍組建後，他受命指揮第17旅，率其參加利比亞、希臘與敘利亞戰役，之後晉升，指揮新幾內亞的第3師（民兵）。
body.en: Between the wars Savige continued in the Militia and by 1939 held the rank of colonel. When the 2nd AIF was raised he was placed in command of 17 Brigade, which he led through the campaigns in Libya, Greece and Syria, before being promoted to command 3 Division (Militia) in New Guinea.

he was placed in command of 17 Brigade

heading.en: II Corps and the Bougainville campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1944年薩維吉受任第2軍司令，指揮布干維爾戰役的部隊，1945年9月在當地接受日軍投降。AWM文章稱，九個多月間，薩維吉中將的澳洲第2軍緩慢推進，戰鬥激烈但規模小，巡邏不斷。
body.en: In 1944 Savige was appointed GOC 2 Corps, in command of forces engaged in the campaign on Bougainville, and accepted the Japanese surrender there in September 1945. An AWM article says that over nine months Lieutenant General Stanley Savige's Australian II Corps made tedious advances; actions were fierce but small-scale, and the patrolling was constant.

heading.en: Later life and the Legacy Clubs

body.zh-Hant: 薩維吉1950年受封大英帝國爵級司令勳章（KBE），1954年去世。AWM稱他因兩次大戰之間創辦「Legacy」俱樂部照顧陣亡與退伍軍人遺屬而廣為人記得；到他去世時，這個全國組織已扶助超過八萬名寡婦與兒童。
body.en: Savige was knighted (KBE) in 1950 and died in 1954. The AWM says he is widely remembered for founding the Legacy Clubs between the wars to care for the dependants of deceased servicemen and ex-servicemen; by the time of his death the nation-wide organisation was supporting over 80 000 widows and children.

heading.en: Taking over Bougainville

body.zh-Hant: 據具名作者里卡德（Rickard）的戰史文章，1944年秋，布干維爾防務移交澳軍，由第2澳洲軍（第3師與第11、第23旅）負責駐防該島。1944年11月22日，薩維吉中將正式接掌指揮，12月12日前完成換防。他決定先攻南部的布因基地，並於1944年12月起偵察海岸一帶的日軍陣地。
body.en: According to a war-history article by Rickard, responsibility for Bougainville passed to the Australians in the autumn of 1944, with II Australian Corps (3rd Division and the 11th and 23rd Brigades) to garrison the island. On 22 November 1944 Lieutenant-General Savige officially took command, and the change-over was completed by 12 December. He chose the southern base at Buin as his first objective and in December 1944 began scouting the Japanese positions along the coast.

heading.en: Origins, teaching and early First World War service

body.zh-Hant: 據澳洲戰爭紀念館（AWM）人物頁，托馬斯·布萊梅1884年1月24日生於瓦加瓦加附近，原為教師，1906年獲任聯邦學員部隊軍官並派駐墨爾本。他1913年畢業於印度奎達參謀學院，1915年4月25日在加里波利登陸。
body.en: Per the Australian War Memorial, Thomas Blamey was born near Wagga Wagga on 24 January 1884. He was originally a teacher, received a commission in the Commonwealth Cadet Forces in 1906 and was posted to Melbourne. He graduated from the Staff College at Quetta in India in 1913 and landed at Gallipoli on 25 April 1915.

citations.quote: born near Wagga Wagga on 24 January 1884
Originally a teacher
received a commission in the Commonwealth Cadet Forces in 1906
was posted to Melbourne
graduated from the Staff College at Quetta in India in 1913
Blamey landed at Gallipoli on 25 April 1915

heading.en: Western Front staff work and the police commissionership

body.zh-Hant: 1915年7月，布萊梅升為臨時中校，返回埃及協助組建第2澳洲師。西線時期他任第1師參謀長並兼一級參謀官，至1918年6月升臨時准將並任澳洲軍參謀長。戰後他赴倫敦任總參謀部上校，並代表澳洲駐帝國參謀本部；1925年任澳洲陸軍副參謀長，不久離開正規軍，出任維多利亞州警察總監並轉入民兵。來源稱他任警察總監期間爭議不斷，1936年因為保護一名高級軍官而說謊，被迫辭職。
body.en: In July 1915 Blamey was promoted to temporary lieutenant colonel and returned to Egypt to help form the 2nd Australian Division. On the Western Front he was Chief of Staff and General Staff Officer 1 in the 1st Division until June 1918, when he became Chief of Staff of the Australian Corps. After the war he went to London as Colonel, General Staff and Australia's representative on the Imperial General Staff; in 1925 he was appointed Second Chief of the Australian General Staff, then left the regular army to become Victoria's commissioner of police and transferred to the militia. The source says his police tenure was dogged by controversy and that he was forced to resign in 1936 having lied to protect one of his senior officers.

heading.zh-Hant: 二戰初期：第6師與澳洲軍
heading.en: The Second World War: 6th Division and the Australian Corps

body.zh-Hant: AWM稱布萊梅在二戰爆發後一個月內獲任第6師指揮官，次年出任澳洲軍司令。來源評為他戰爭初期表現參差，部分下屬質疑他是否適任指揮，但他仍獲晉升，1941年12月升任上將。
body.en: The AWM says that within a month of the Second World War beginning Blamey was given command of the 6th Division, and the following year he became commander of the Australian Corps. It describes a mixed early performance, with some subordinates questioning his fitness for command, yet he received further promotions and in December 1941 reached the rank of General.

heading.zh-Hant: 陸軍總司令與新幾內亞攻勢
heading.en: Commander-in-Chief and the New Guinea offensives

body.zh-Hant: 1942年3月，日本已參戰，布萊梅返回墨爾本出任澳洲軍事部隊總司令，並在麥克阿瑟之下兼任盟軍陸上部隊司令。來源說麥克阿瑟深得總理信任，他又為許多澳洲高級軍官所不滿，因此困難重重；在麥克阿瑟壓力下撤換巴布亞多名高級軍官，至今仍有爭議。他在1943年於新幾內亞發動一連串成功攻勢。
body.en: In March 1942, with Japan in the war, Blamey returned to Melbourne as Commander-in-Chief of the Australian Military Forces and, under General Douglas MacArthur, became commander of Allied land forces in the Pacific. The source says MacArthur had the prime minister's ear and that Blamey was resented by many senior Australian officers, so he met numerous difficulties; his removal of several senior officers in Papua under pressure from MacArthur remains controversial. He conducted a series of successful offensives in New Guinea in 1943.

heading.en: Postwar retirement and field marshal's rank

body.zh-Hant: 戰後布萊梅退休回到墨爾本，1950年6月8日晉升元帥，成為第一位達到此階的澳洲陸軍軍官。他於1951年5月27日去世。AWM引述一位歷史學家的評語：他是二戰最傑出的澳洲將領，但不會被記為最偉大的一位。
body.en: After the war Blamey retired to Melbourne and was promoted to field marshal on 8 June 1950, becoming the first Australian army officer to reach that rank. He died on 27 May 1951. The AWM quotes a historian describing him as the foremost Australian General of World War II who will never be remembered as the greatest.

heading.zh-Hant: 皇家空軍借調與空軍參謀長
heading.en: RAF secondment and Chief of the Air Staff

body.zh-Hant: 據澳洲戰爭紀念館（AWM）館藏頁，空軍上將查爾斯·伯納特原任英國皇家空軍總監察長，後由該軍種借調，出任澳洲皇家空軍參謀長，期間為1940至1942年。Camp Columbia遺產協會的文章稱，他是借調到澳洲的英國皇家空軍高級軍官，1940年任參謀長，負責澳洲皇家空軍的作戰整備，並與盟國空軍和情報當局聯絡。
body.en: Per the Australian War Memorial, Air Chief Marshal Sir Charles Burnett, a former Inspector General of the Royal Air Force, was seconded from that service and appointed Chief of Air Staff, RAAF, for the period 1940–1942. A Camp Columbia Heritage Association article says he was a senior RAF officer seconded to Australia, appointed Chief of the Air Staff in 1940, who held responsibility for the operational readiness of the RAAF and for liaison with Allied air and intelligence authorities.

heading.en: The December 1941 discussions on Dutch intelligence

body.zh-Hant: 1941年12月初，伯納特參與高層會談，審議荷蘭情報來源的資訊。與會者有澳洲高級軍官、美國武官，以及代表巴達維亞當局的荷蘭聯絡官。該文認為，這使他成為戰爭爆發前夕傳遞與評估荷蘭情報警訊的澳方關鍵人物。
body.en: In early December 1941 Burnett took part in high-level discussions in which information from Dutch intelligence sources was reviewed. The discussions involved senior Australian officers, the United States military attaché and a Dutch liaison officer representing authorities in Batavia. The article argues this made him a key Australian figure in transmitting and evaluating Dutch intelligence warnings in the days before the Pacific war.

heading.zh-Hant: 太平洋戰爭初期的空權與情報協調
heading.en: Coordinating air power and intelligence early in the Pacific war

body.zh-Hant: 珍珠港事件與太平洋戰爭迅速擴大之後，澳洲成為盟軍行動的主要基地，該文稱伯納特在這段過渡期繼續擔任協調空權與情報合作的核心角色。1942年初荷屬東印度落入日軍之手，荷蘭軍事與情報機構被迫流亡，澳洲遂成為重組的重心。文章也說，他並非隸屬荷蘭情報組織。
body.en: The article says that after Pearl Harbor and the rapid expansion of the Pacific War, when Australia became a major base for Allied operations, Burnett continued to play a central role in coordinating air power and intelligence cooperation. As the Netherlands East Indies fell to Japanese forces in early 1942, Dutch military and intelligence organisations were forced into exile and Australia became the focal point for their reorganisation. It adds that Burnett was not attached to Dutch intelligence organisations.
